entities.summary: Zachary Fucale is a Canadian professional ice hockey goaltender for HC Dinamo Minsk of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He was selected in the second round, 36th overall, by the Montreal Canadiens in the 2013 NHL Entry Draft. He has previously played for the Washington Capitals in the National Hockey League (NHL).
